title: Grief and vulnerability
learning_outcomes: Explain grief variability in the context of grief and vulnerability.
Compare and distinguish cultural context in the context of grief and vulnerability.
Apply voluntary disclosure in the context of grief and vulnerability.
Evaluate and justify decisions about support options in the context of grief and vulnerability.

lessons.title: Grief variability
lessons.outcome: Explain grief variability in the context of grief and vulnerability.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving grief variability; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to fictional bereavement support plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain grief variability from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of grief variability; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Cultural context
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish cultural context in the context of grief and vulnerability.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving cultural context; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to fictional bereavement support plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain cultural context from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of cultural context; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Voluntary disclosure
lessons.outcome: Apply voluntary disclosure in the context of grief and vulnerability.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving voluntary disclosure; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to fictional bereavement support plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain voluntary disclosure from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of voluntary disclosure; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Support options
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about support options in the context of grief and vulnerability.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving support options; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to fictional bereavement support plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain support options from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of support options; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of grief variability; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of cultural context; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of voluntary disclosure; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of support options; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
